items.title: 3D Longplays  for Nintendo New-3DS
items.description:
A collection of 3D Longplays encoded specifically for playback on an unlocked New3DS. I don't expect good playback on the original 3DS. Note: Only download the .avi files not the auto generated .mp4 files.

To playback these longplays, Video Player for 3DS is required
